name: sharp
description: Keeps humans sharp while AI does the work: one-way door gates with decision cards, 6 Ws change briefs with impact, first-principles reasoning, predict-first coaching, and spaced review of what you learned from your own work.

mode.title: Coaching mode
mode.description: off = gate only · light = gate + change briefs (default) · coach = + predict-first and check-yourself · learn = + hint ladder

detail.title: Detail level
detail.description: How much sharp adds to answers. brief = just the essentials (default) · standard = full 6 Ws + impact · full = everything incl. rollback and alternatives

role.title: Your role
role.description: Tailors what 'verified' means and which actions count as one-way doors. engineer · legal · student · general

focus.title: Growth focus areas (optional)
focus.description: Comma-separated topics where you want deliberate practice even when busy, e.g. 'sql, migrations, indemnities'. Everywhere else sharp stays fast.

mentor.title: Mentor (optional)
mentor.description: Who to check with before one-way doors, e.g. '@priya'. Shown on Decision Cards; nothing is sent to them.
